comparison_tracks.description: Measure whether standard/core.md v0.2.0 improves spec fidelity (removing unrequested hardcoded field exclusions and local capacity caps while preserving caller opt-in bounds) and Stage 2 PR summary brevity/credibility on SE3.

Ablate per-model delta overlays (specifically evaluating candidate D-OPU-5 POLICY_CONFLICT/SPEC_DEVIATION halt rule + D-OPU-4 brevity on claude-opus-5-5 alongside Astra/Sol/Neon deltas) layered on top of standard/core.md v0.2.0 on SE3.
End-to-end comparison of standard/core.md v0.2.0 + per-model delta overlays against provider-native baseline on SE3.

limits: Completed 36-run (72-stage, 0 timeouts/failures/blocked) isolated spec-fidelity pilot (results/pilot-spec-fidelity-v0.9.0/runs.jsonl): 12/12 (100.0%) mechanical pass across all three arms (baseline, core-rules-v0.2.0, model-controls; 12/12 strict wc -w <= 120; 0/36 diff_check findings).

SE3 is framed as an explicit bug-removal task with failing unit tests asserting skin_tone and >1 MB payloads, which produced a 100% baseline accuracy ceiling (INCONCLUSIVE on pass rate) and exposed +48.5% USD / +71.2% token overhead on claude-opus-5-5 under model-controls (D-OPU-1..5); D-OPU-5 therefore stays a task-scoped candidate rather than a standing global prompt rule.

Replicates (n = 3 per model x condition cell) do not test unprompted greenfield policy invention or multi-agent policy laundering without explicit failing tests; a harder greenfield probe (without explicit removal instructions) is required to trigger covert constraint invention.
